title: Vickers Wellington HZ251
memorial_details: Rectangular stone wall surmounted by a flying eagle and inset plaque with the dedication. The wall incorporates parts of the wreakage. Next to the wall is a bench with a plaque stating 'Happy memories of Josef (one of the fallen) from Josephine (His wife)
inscription: LEST WE FORGET/ In memory of the Polish airmen who lost/ their lives here/ flying a Vickers Wellington XI HZ251/ on September 23rd 1943/ (Names)/ The Fallen/ They have passed beyond the stress and/ storm of mortal strife/ through the gateways of the morning to a wider life/ asking only this of us, that we with faith/ and pride/ remember in the after years the things for/ which they died. (Patience Strong)
